szz_methodology_note: Commit-attributed source-file-overlap SZZ via `git -c diff.renames=false log --no-renames --first-parent --name-only` (file-level granularity, coarser than line-level git blame; zero --numstat blob fetches); `fix_induces_fix_k60d` strictly bounded to delta_days <= 60.0; `pre_pr_14d_hotspot_fixes` (-14.0 <= delta_days < 0.0, symmetric to `szz_bugfix_14d`), `pre_pr_30d_hotspot_fixes` & `pre_pr_30d_hotspot_commits` (-30.0 <= delta_days < 0.0); `file_survival_30d_pct` is bugfix-only (bug-fix commits + reverts in 30d), whereas `file_survival_14d_pct` (0 < delta_days <= 14.0) and `file_survival_30d_all_commits_pct` (0 < delta_days <= 30.0) track all-commit turnover survival.
